# archelinux

> archelinux is an independent, rolling-release Arch-based workstation for x86_64. Its recommended desktop uses SwayFX and Waybar with Foot, Zsh, tmux, and Neovim. You can choose your tools at installation and edit the configuration files in your home directory.

The signed installation ISO boots Linux LTS and needs internet access to fetch packages. The installer offers XFS with optional LUKS encryption and can install a console-only system. System updates use pacman with Arch repositories and the signed archelinux stable channel.

Optional developer tooling includes `arche-agentic-core`. It supplies development runtimes, code search tools, and opt-in user services for Ollama and llama.cpp. Local inference services are disabled by default.

## Install and get started

- [Download](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/download/): Current stable installation ISO and verification files.
- [Installation guide](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/installation.html): Network setup, disk choices, and software selection.
- [Verify the ISO](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/verify.html): Release key, signatures, and checksums.
- [First session](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/first-session.html): Desktop, terminal, and editor basics.
- [Hardware notes](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/hardware.html): Graphics and hardware considerations.

## Updates, packages, and recovery

- [Rolling updates](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/rolling-updates.html): Keep an installed system current.
- [Recovery](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/wiki/recovery.html): Alternate console and boot options, and cached package rollback.
- [Package directory](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/packages/): Current archelinux package catalog.
- [Release news](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/news/): Release announcements and changes.

## Source and support

- [Distribution source](https://github.com/archelinux/archelinux): Installer, ISO profile, package recipes, and tests.
- [Architecture and optional tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archelinux/archelinux/main/docs/architecture.md): Build layout, developer packages, and local model services in Markdown.
- [Report an issue](https://archelinux.github.io/archelinux.org/issues/): Report a bug or share hardware compatibility details.
